rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a toenail.

example.english: My toenail has grown too long and is pressing against my shoe, which is uncomfortable.
example.traditional: 我隻腳甲生得太長，頂住隻鞋，好唔舒服。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 gaap3 saang1 dak1 taai3 coeng4 ding2 zyu6 zek3 haai4 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this more explicit form when you want to contrast a toenail with a fingernail.

example.english: The doctor asked whether I had injured a fingernail or a toenail, and I said it was a toenail.
example.traditional: 醫生問我係手指甲定腳指甲撞傷，我話係腳指甲。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 man6 ngo5 hai6 sau2 zi2 gaap3 ding6 goek3 zi2 gaap3 zong6 soeng1 ngo5 waa6 hai6 goek3 zi2 gaap3
